intro.text: A merchant who does modestly well hiring out chull teams to caravans crossing the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Chanasha was paid to stay in a secure place for a month while Shallan impersonated her to get into the Sons of Honor.

appearance.text: A lighteyed woman of low dahn who wears a safehand sleeve.

personality.text: Not the smiling type, she is known as a shrewd negotiator. She always carries a reed in her pocket and never lets a day pass without balancing her accounts.
